title: Cookie Policy Privacy Notice
desc:
The website you are visiting (“www.vstarstransfer.com”), which belongs to the Company, uses cookies. A cookie is a small text file, mostly consisting of letters and numbers, that is stored on the terminal devices being used, allowing the device to be identified.
The purpose of this Cookie Privacy Notice is to inform you about the types of cookies we use, the purposes for which we use them, and how you can manage these cookies regarding the processing of your personal data obtained automatically through the placement of cookies used on our Website on your terminal devices.
1: 1. WHAT TYPES OF COOKIES ARE USED?
1Desc: It is possible to classify cookie types into three categories: cookies according to their purpose of use, cookies according to their duration, and cookies according to their parties.
11Desc: We use four types of cookies according to their purpose of use. These are: Performance/Analytical, Functional, and Strictly Necessary Cookies.
111Desc: These cookies help us monitor visits and traffic, learn which pages are the most and least popular, and see how customers navigate the site so that we can measure and improve the performance of our Website. All information collected by these cookies is anonymized. If you do not allow these cookies, we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor your performance.
googleAnalyticsDesc: It is a statistics service that measures how the site is used. Data such as the number of visits, page views, traffic source, and approximate location are collected; the site is improved with this data. The data may be processed on the servers of Google LLC (USA). https://policies.google.com/privacy
112Desc: These cookies allow the Website to offer enhanced functionality and personalization. Functional identification cookies may be set by the Company or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow functional identification cookies, some or all of these services may not function properly. For example: Your language preference.
gooleMapsDesc: It is an embedded map on the page; it is loaded from Google servers for location display and may leave preference cookies. The data may be processed on the servers of Google LLC (USA). https://policies.google.com/privacy
113Desc: These cookies are necessary for the Website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. Strictly necessary identification cookies are obligatorily used to fulfill an information society service requested by the user (for example; filling out forms, remembering privacy preferences). You can set your browser to block or alert you about strictly necessary identification cookies; however, in this case, some parts of our website will not work as intended.
googleCaptchaDesc: It is a security service that protects forms from automated submissions (bots). The data may be processed on the servers of Google LLC (USA). https://policies.google.com/privacy
12Desc: As a Company, we use persistent cookies based on their duration.
121Desc: Persistent cookies, which are not automatically deleted when the internet browser is closed, are automatically deleted on a specific date or after a certain period of time.
131Desc: They are placed on the device directly by the visited Website or the Company.
132Desc: These are cookies placed on the device by a third party, such as an analytical system. For example: Google Analytics.
2: 2. Explicit Consent and Withdrawal of Consent
2Desc1: Your explicit consent for cookies other than strictly necessary cookies is obtained through the cookie banner displayed upon your first entry to our site. The banner presents the accept and reject options equally; until you make a decision, these cookies are not placed and the relevant services are not loaded.
2Desc2: You can withdraw your consent at any time: you can use the cookie preferences link on the site or delete the cookies belonging to our site from your browser. The withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
2Desc3: Google services on our site depend on Google Consent Mode v2 signals (ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization); until you make a decision, these signals are kept in the "denied" state, and are updated to "granted" if you accept.
3Desc: The servers of some service providers we use are located abroad. In this context, your personal data may be transferred in accordance with Article 9 of the KVKK (Personal Data Protection Law, as amended by Law No. 7499); to countries with an adequacy decision or provided that appropriate safeguards (undertaking, standard contract) are provided. The services that may transfer data abroad are:
d: Google Maps (embedded map): Data may be processed on Google LLC (USA) servers. Google reCAPTCHA: Data may be processed on Google LLC (USA) servers. Google Analytics 4: Data may be processed on Google LLC (USA) servers.
4: Obligation to Inform and Retention Periods
4Desc: This policy has been prepared considering the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles to be Complied with in Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform. The retention period for each cookie is stated in the tables above; expired cookies are automatically deleted by your browser. Personal data obtained through cookies are stored for a period not exceeding the time required by the processing purpose.
5: Contact for your rights and requests
5Desc: You can submit your questions regarding your personal data and your rights and requests under Article 11 of the KVKK with a petition drawn up in accordance with the conditions specified in the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller, or via your e-mail address to the e-mail address vstarstransfer34@gmail.com.
6Desc: European Union: For visitors in the EU, prior consent is essential for non-mandatory cookies in accordance with GDPR (Article 6/1-a) and ePrivacy rules; rights under Articles 15 to 21 of the GDPR are reserved.
7Desc:
You can also view, delete individually or in bulk, and block cookies from your browser settings. If you block strictly necessary cookies, some parts of the site may not work. Help pages for common browsers:
